recipe.title: Balinese chicken curry
recipe.notes: This is a Nadia Lim recipe that Amy and I first made on 23 August 2020 during the second covid-19 pandemic lockdown.

i.n: fresh turmeric, peeled (or 1 tsp ground turmeric)
tamarind puree (or 1 Tbs lemon juice and 1 tsp brown sugar)
chicken thighs, skinless and boneless, diced to 3cm
kaffir/makrut lime leaves, tough stalk removed, very finely sliced
red chilli, very finely sliced lengthwise
kaffir/makrut lime leaf, very finely sliced lengthwise

method.s: Place curry paste ingredients into a food processor and blend into a smooth paste. The paste can be made ahead of time and frozen.
Heat a drizzle of oil in a large pan on medium heat. Add 3/4 C of curry paste and fry for 4 minutes until very fragrant, stirring continuously to prevent sticking.
Add another drizzle of oil, the onion and a pinch of salt, and cook until onion is very soft (about 5 minutes). Add 1 Tbs water if mixture begins to stick to pan.
Add chicken and fry for 8-10 minutes or until lightly golden.

Add coconut milk, soy sauce, fish sauce and kaffir lime leaves and simmer for about 8 minutes until chicken is cooked through and sauce has intensified in colour and thickened slightly. Season to taste with lime juice.
Garnish with extra roasted cashews, thinly sliced red chilli, kaffir lime leaf.
Serve with rice, a handful of beansprouts, diced cucumber and a lime wedge on the side.
